note: The allies (tenants) of thealliancedao.com — ONE curated list, read by the crons (which collections an ally's service runs) and by the site (the header tenant dropdown, /<slug> default, logos, theme). Add an ally = a block here + its collection folders in nft-collections + one Render service per cron family (org-nft-inventory-<slug>, org-nft-flows-<slug>). Remove an ally = delete its block, stop its services, delete its folders — nothing else changes. `default: true` marks the site's default tenant.
